target_reference_entry:
[19] C. Wang et al., “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID
by capturing sub-mm level vibration,”Proc. ACM Interactive, Mobile,
Wearable Ubiquitous Technol., vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
paper_level_summary_zh: 本论文在相关工作中提及目标论文[19]作为RFID振动感知的代表性工作，并指出RFID技术在微米级振动场景下精度受限，从而引出mmWave雷达的优势。正文未涉及对目标论文的亚毫米级精度、穿墙窃听或RFID扬声器振动能力的直接确认或使用。

evidences.evidence_quote: The works mentioned above are dedicated to analyzing the frequency of mechanical vibration. Displacement is also an essential parameter of mechanical vibration. However, in the scenario of micron mechanical vibration, the accuracy of longer wavelength RF signals (e.g., RFID[19], WiFi[20]) is limited.
evidences.evidence_context: The works mentioned above are dedicated to analyzing the frequency of mechanical vibration. Displacement is also an essential parameter of mechanical vibration. evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引文仅将[19]作为RFID振动感知的例子，在微米级精度场景下指出其精度不足，属于普通相关文献引用，没有确认目标论文的亚毫米级能力，反而暗示其局限性。因此判定为ordinary_reference，且推荐exclude。
